title: Collateral Protection Master Policy, Equipment & Vehicle Loans — Term of Coverage Charged
content:
**Clause.** The coverage term an Equipment & Vehicle Loans collateral protection premium is charged for depends on how the lapse stands on the placement date: when more than 30 days have passed since the insurance expiry date on record, the coverage is backdated and runs from the day after that expiry date through one year after the placement date, so the premium is charged for the days since the expiry date plus 365 days; when 30 days or fewer have passed since the expiry date and fewer than 12 whole months remain to the maturity date, the coverage runs only to the maturity date and the premium is charged for the days from the placement date to the maturity date; otherwise the premium is charged for 365 days. The premium for the days charged is the annual premium figure multiplied by the days charged and divided by 365, rounded to cents only at the end.

## Days charged

| Days since the insurance expiry date on record, at placement | Whole months remaining to the maturity date | Days charged |
|---|---|---|
| more than 30 | any | the days since the expiry date plus 365 |
| 30 or fewer | fewer than 12 | the days from the placement date to the maturity date |
| 30 or fewer | 12 or more | 365 |

## Both sides of the 30-day line (hypothetical expiry date 1 May, maturity years away)

| Placement date | Days since expiry | Days charged |
|---|---|---|
| 31 May | 30 | 365 |
| 1 June | 31 | 31 plus 365, that is 396 |

## Hypothetical worked figures

- Placement 20 days after expiry, maturity date 200 days after placement (fewer than 12 whole months away): 200 days are charged, so an annual figure of 2730.00 becomes 2730.00 multiplied by 200 and divided by 365, which is 1495.890…, rounded to 1495.89.
- Placement 45 days after expiry: 410 days are charged, so the same annual figure becomes 2730.00 multiplied by 410 and divided by 365, which is 3066.575…, rounded to 3066.58.
